summary: {person} has to plan where people in county custody could go if the river rises.
realLife: King County reviewed the possible transfer of people held at the Maleng Regional Justice Center ahead of winter flooding.
inGame: needs: custody placements during a flood advisory.

turns.what: People in custody remain at the facility.
turns.pulledBy: An updated assessment keeps the jail outside the projected flooding.
turns.writesBack: The county cancels the transfer request.

turns.what: The county moves only the occupied ground-floor units.
turns.pulledBy: Upper floors and essential services remain available.
turns.writesBack: The roster identifies the transfers and receiving locations.
